tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus dkyil chog gi mchan bu ma dag pa'i 'khrul sel bzhugs// thams cad mkhyen pa 'khor lo'i mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ding sang dus 'dir sngags la sbyangs pa nyung / /de phyir cho ga dag dang ma dag pa'i/ /rnam dbye shes pa nyin mo'i skar ma tsam/ /'on kyang rang nyid gsung rab brjod don la/ /ma rmongs rab gsal blo mig dang ldan phyir/ /blo gsal gzur gnas 'ga' la phan rung snyam/ /gsang 'dus dkyil chog mchan bu ma dag pa'i/ /rjes 'brangs 'khrul sel lhag bsam dag pas bris/ /de la 'dir snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po de nyid kyi gsung las/ kho bos byas pa'i gsang 'dus kyi yig cha 'di la da dung zhus dag dang dogs dpyod 'dra dgos pa yod do zhes gsungs pa dus mtshungs pa'i skye bo bden par smra ba du ma'i ngag las thos pa dang / lhag par dkyil chog gi sta gon gyi skabs kyi mchan bu 'di ni/ sngags 'chang nyid kyi dgongs pa yin par yang ma nges shing / ma dag pa'i tshul bshad par bya ste/ dkyil chog gi sta gon gyi skabs kyi mchan bu de nyid kyi rjes su 'brangs na/ sta gon gyi snga dro sgrub thabs bsdus pa'i lugs kyi dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dor ba'i rjes su/ phra thig dang bzlas pa grub rjes/ gtso bo don dam la zhugs pa dang / lha mo bzhi'i glus bskul ba/ gtso bo 'od gsal las sems dpa' gsum brtsegs kyi skur bzhengs pa la bstod pa dang mchod pa sogs bya ba rnams sgrub thabs nas ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin byed dgos par bshad 'dug pa ltar/ deng sang ngag 'don la yang byed pa zhig 'dug mod kyang / 'di ni sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i sgrub dkyil gyi rtsom gzhi/ rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rab/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyi zur 'debs mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog sogs kyi dgongs pa ma yin zhing /

'dus pa 'phags lugs kyi yig cha tshad ldan gzhan las kyang de ltar du ma bshad pa'i phyir/ mchan bu ma dag pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i ngag 'don 'di bzhin 'dor bar bya'o/ /'o na ji ltar du snyam na/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs 'di la nyams su len tshul rgyas bsdus gnyis gsungs pa las/ sta gon gyi snga dro mdzad pa 'di bsdus pa'i phyogs yin zhing / de'i tshe skyabs 'gro nas bzung rjes chags kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza sogs brjod pa yan chad sgrub thabs bzhin byas la/ 'on kyang cung zad mi 'dra ba ni lha mos lus la bsdu ba'i tshe/ rang gi snying kha'i 'od zer gyis lha rnams gdan dang bcas pa spyan drangs te/ rang gi lus kyi gnas so sor 'khod pa ni spyi bor rnam par snang mdzad sogs sgrub thabs bzhin bya'o/ /de nas phra thig dang bzlas pa grub rjes/ rang gi lus gzhal yas khang du gyur pa'i nang du aṃ las mchod yon ma dkar mo zhes sogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pa yan gyi mchod pa rnams sgrub thabs nas ji ltar bshad pa bzhin byas la/ de nas sngar rang gi lus las spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis bstod par bsam la/ mi bskyod rdo rje'i ye shes che/ /zhes pa nas/ rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pa'i bar gyis bstod la/ de nas nyer bsdu bya ba ni/ rang gi thugs kha'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyi gzhal yas khang spyan drangs nas rang gi lus kyi dkyil 'khor la thim pas rang zhe sdang rdo rje yab yum du gyur/ ces brjod la/ de nas sa'i lha mo sta gon la 'jug par bya ste/ de ltar yin pa'i rgyu mtshan rje rdo rje 'chang gi sgrub thabs dngos grub rgya mtsho las/ thun 'og ma gsum la'ang sngar bzhin rgyas par bsgom pa'am/ de tsam mi nus na skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du 'gro bas/ srung 'khor nas rjes chags kyi mchod pa yan chod dang po sbyor ba rdzogs par bsgom la/

de'i mthar bzlas pa dang mchod bstod nyer bsdu sogs bya'o/ /de'i tshe lha mos lus la bsdu ba'i skabs su gdan rnams kyang rang la bsdu'o/ /zhes gsal bar gsungs shing / paṇa chen gung ru shes rab bzang po'i gsang 'dus kyi phyag len gyi rim pa gsal ba zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos las/ yang sbyin sreg dus sam/ sgrub mchod kyi sta gon dus su sgrub thabs bsdus pa 'di bzhin bsgom pa yang shin tu gal che bas/ de'i tshul ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ yig brgya bzlas pa sogs byas nas/ lha mos lus la bsdu ba'i skabs su/ rang gi snying kha'i 'od zer gyis lha rnams gdan dang bcas pa spyan drangs te rang gi lus kyi gnas so sor thim pa ni/ spyi bor rnam par snang mdzad ces sogs te/ gdan rnams kyang bsdu'o/ /sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rjes su dkyil 'khor gyi rjes su dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog mi byed par bzlas pa dang sbrel te/ bzlas pa'i rjes su mchod bstod nyer bsdu bya ste/ sgrub thabs rgyas pa ltar na/ 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi bstod pa'i rjes su lus las spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa yin pas bstod pa dang por 'byung la/ 'dir ni 'khor gyi lha tshogs med par lus la spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa'i rjes la bstod pa yin pas/ bstod pa rjes su byung ba yin te/ sgrub mchod kyi skabs 'ga' rer yang go rim 'di bzhin byed dgos so/ /nyer bsdu'i skabs su thugs kha'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis rten gzhal yas khang pa spyan drangs te rang gi lus kyi dkyil 'khor la thim pas rang zhe sdang rdo rje zhes pa man chod bya ste/ brten pa lha 'khor bsdu rgyu med do/ /zhes rgyu mtshan dang bcas gsal bar gsungs pa dang / yang gung ru'i gsang 'dus kyi rnam bshad chen po las/ de ltar ting nge 'dzin gsum rdzogs par bsgom pa'i thun gzhan la dang po sbyor ba'i rjes su bzlas pa sogs sbyar sgrub thabs bsdus pa rung ste/

sgron gsal le'u bcu bdun par/ de lta bu'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa 'ba' zhig gsungs pas so/ /sgrub thabs bsdus pa 'di bzhin bsgom rung ba'i khungs ston par mdzad cing / yang mkhas pa chen po dkon mchog lhun grub kyi zur 'debs mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog las kyang / de tsam mi nus na/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas rnams byas la/ tshad med bzhi bsgom pa nas lhag mos kyi mdzad pa'i bar ji skad bshad pa bzhin byas nas/ lhag mos lus la bsdu ba'i tshe/ /rang gi snying kha'i 'od zer gyis lha rnams gdan dang bcas pa spyan drangs te rang gi lus kyi gnas so sor thim pa ni/ spyi bor rnam snang zhes sogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu dza badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i bar byas nas bzlas pa bya/ phyi nang gi mchod pa sngar bzhin byas la/ lha mo de rnams kyis bstod par bsam ste sngar bzhin bstod/ nyer bsdu'i tshe rang gi thugs kha'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis gzhal yas khang spyan drangs te/ rang gi lus kyi dkyil 'khor la thim pas/ rang zhe sdang rdo rjer gyur ces brjod/ de nas sa lha'i sgos mchod kyi mar mi sbar la/ zhes gsungs pas rgyu mtshan de rnams kyi phyir/ kho bos gong du bshad pa ltar nyams su blangs pas bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsung rab so so'i dgongs pa dang mthun zhing / sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i dgongs pa yang rdzogs par 'gyur bas/ gsung rab kyi don la dpyod pa'i blo gros dang ldan zhing blo gzu bor gnas pa rnams kyis dgongs par mdzad de/ rgyu mtshan des na mchan bu ma dag pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i nyams len gyi rim pa de la ni/ gong ma'i gsung rab de rnams dang 'gal ba'i lung gi gnod byed de tsam du ma zad/ rigs pas kyang 'di ltar gnod de/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang ma 'brel bzhin du gtso bo don dam la zhugs nas/

de las bzhengs par spyan ma la sogs pa lha mo bzhi'i glu'i bskul bar gsungs pa la skabs der skul byed kyi lha mo bzhi med pa'i phyir dang / gtso bo don dam las bzhengs te sems dpa' gsum brtsegs kyi bdag nyid can du dkyil 'khor pa thams cad kyis mthong bar 'gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsgom dgos pa las/ skabs der sngar bskyed pa'i lha rnams ni lhag mos lus la bsdu ba'i tshe bsdus zin nas med pa dang / de'i rjes su dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang ma 'brel bas dkyil 'khor gyi lha gzhan bskyed pa med pa'i phyir rang sems dpa' gsum brtsegs kyi bdag nyid can du dkyil 'khor pa thams cad kyis mthong bar 'gyur zhes pa'i dkyil 'khor pa rnams gang la ngos 'dzin smra dgos pa sogs mang du yod kyang 'dir ma spros so/ /gzhan yang gsang ba 'dus pa'i bdag 'jug gi skabs su rnam snang sogs kyi dbang rdzas 'ga' zhig la dbang rdzas lhar bskyed nas de'i ye shes pa spyan drangs te mi bstim par/ de'i spyi bor zla ba la oṃ dkar po sogs gnas gsum byin rlabs byed pa zhig 'dug kyang / 'di ni dbang rdzas so so'i ye shes pa spyan drangs pa'i rjes su/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ zhes thams cad la sbyar la/ de nas gnas gsum byin rlabs rnams bya dgos pa yin te/ de bzhin bya bar chos rgyal 'phags pas mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus kyi bdag 'jug dang / rdo rje 'chang gi dkyil chog ye shes rgya mtsho/ gung ru shes bzang gi dkyil chog rim pa gsal ba/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gyi dkyil chog ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyi zur 'debs mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog ste gsung rab de thams cad mthun par dbang rdzas kyi ye shes pa bstims pa'i rjes su gnas gsum byin rlabs bya dgos pa kho na gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa 'di ni 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i mtshan can las lugs 'di'i sgrub dkyil gyi lung sogs nos shing /

rgyal sras sbas pa'i rnal 'byor sems dpa' chen po grags pa'i mtshan can las smin byed kyi bdud rtsi'i ro mchog myangs la/ gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son cing / dus gsum sgrib med du gzigs pa'i rgyal ba mus pa chen po las dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i grol byed kyi zab khrid kyi rim pa smin rgyas su stsal te/ de dang 'brel ba'i yig cha mdo byas/ mdo bsres/ rnam gzhag rim pa/ spyod bsdus sgron me sogs rgya gzhung mang po dang / de'i dgongs 'grel bod kyi gsung rab mtshan ldan mang po'i bshad lung sogs mtha' chod par bka' drin gyis bskyangs pa'i skal ba bzang po can dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis sbyar ba 'dis rang gzhan kun la phan bde rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig de ltar bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa yis/ /gsang 'dus cho ga'i 'khrul sel bris 'di la/ /mang thos blo gsal rnam dpyod ldan pa rnams/ /dges par mdzod la kun la spel bar gyis/ /la la rang nyid gsung rab dgongs don gyi/ /tshig re tsam gyi don la'ang rab rmongs kyang / /phyogs 'dzin dbang gis log rtog sgrog na yang / /de la kho bo ba spu g.yo re skan/ /'di sbyar dge bas bdag sogs gdul bya rnams/ /tshe 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub/ /phyi ma bde ba can du skyes gyur nas/ /kun kyang bdag gi 'dul byar 'gyur bar shog/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i gsang 'dus dkyil chog gi mchan bu ma dag pa'i 'khrul sel/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
